fullTextZH: 我要和Luna我们一起看一个电影。
fullTextEN: I want to watch a movie with Luna.
I like watching movies the most.
The kitchen is not the bedroom.
I think it's 6 in the morning.
Do you think 6 in the morning is early,
Do you think he got up,
or is he going to sleep?
Luna, what time do you get up?
Do you think you get up early?
I think it's neither early nor late.

fullTextZH: 你觉得这个男人要去做什么？
fullTextEN: What do you think this man is going to do?
Get up, then wash face and brush teeth.

fullTextZH: 我看到了很多很多鸡蛋。
有一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十，
fullTextEN: There are one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten,
So what do you think he is going to do?
Weixuan, he didn't brush his teeth or wash his face.

fullTextZH: 那你觉得他会做煎鸡蛋，
fullTextEN: So do you think he will make fried eggs,
I think he can fry eggs.

fullTextZH: 因为你喜欢吃煎鸡蛋吗？
fullTextEN: Is it because you like to eat fried eggs?
Then who is he making fried eggs for?
A boy is not a man.
Who do you think this boy is?

fullTextZH: 我觉得这个男孩是他的儿子。
fullTextEN: I think this boy is his son.
What does he want to do?
I think he washes his face and brushes his teeth.
Does he want to fry eggs?
What is he going to do.

fullTextZH: Luna，这个鸡蛋看起来怎么样？
fullTextEN: Luna, how does this egg look?

fullTextZH: 我觉得这个鸡蛋看起来很好吃，
fullTextEN: I think this egg looks delicious,

fullTextZH: 这个鸡蛋看起来煎了1分钟、2分钟。
fullTextEN: This egg looks like it was fried for 1 minute, 2 minutes.

fullTextZH: 这个小男孩他在做什么？
fullTextEN: What is this little boy doing?
"I'm very hungry, my egg is coming soon!
Do you also want to eat eggs?
I want to eat fried eggs.
Do you think this egg is tasty?
I think this boy likes it.
Now you are the little boy,
Luna, what time is it now?
What do you think he is going to do?
He doesn't wash his face or brush his teeth.
I think he's making eggs again.
Is Dad making fried eggs today?
Do you like to eat egg pancakes?
I like to eat egg pancakes.
Then what do you think about his son—
Will he like this egg pancake?
I think he will like it.

fullTextZH: 为什么今天这个鸡蛋也不好吃？”
fullTextEN: why doesn't this egg taste good today either?"
Luna, what is this man doing?
I think he wants to climb,
and there is a tree here.
He wants to take the bird eggs,

fullTextZH: 这个鸟蛋是什么颜色的？
fullTextEN: What color are these bird eggs?
Have you eaten blue bird eggs?
I haven't eaten blue bird eggs.

fullTextZH: 这个男人会拿走鸟蛋吗？
fullTextEN: will this man take the bird eggs?
Right, he wants to make bird eggs—
Do you think he took it?
He doesn't seem to have taken the bird eggs.
Luna, what is the date today?
Luna, if you eat eggs from May 1st to May 11th
I think I want to vomit.

fullTextZH: 他做了很多很多鸡蛋，对不对？
fullTextEN: He made a lot of eggs, right?
Yes, he made them for 11 days.
Weixuan, he only made 3 kinds of eggs:

fullTextZH: 煎鸡蛋、鸡蛋饼和煮鸡蛋。
fullTextEN: Fried eggs, egg pancakes, and boiled eggs.
He doesn't like any of them.
So, what do you think about tomorrow,
He can make the fourth kind of egg.

fullTextZH: 可是他现在看起来开心吗？
fullTextEN: But does he look happy now?
Luna, what time is it now?

fullTextZH: 蔚萱，我觉得爸爸不想做鸡蛋了。
fullTextEN: Weixuan, I think dad doesn't want to make eggs anymore.
It's not morning now, it's evening.
Did his son fall asleep too?
He is watching a video on making eggs.

fullTextZH: 你觉得这个小男孩要做什么？
fullTextEN: What do you think this little boy wants to do?

fullTextZH: 他觉得爸爸做鸡蛋不好吃，
fullTextEN: He thinks dad's eggs don't taste good,

fullTextZH: 那你觉得他要做煎鸡蛋
fullTextEN: So do you think he wants to make fried eggs
He wants to make fried eggs.
he wants to fry two eggs,

fullTextZH: 你觉得他爸爸也会喜欢这个煎鸡蛋吗？
fullTextEN: Do you think his dad will also like this fried egg?

fullTextZH: 我觉得爸爸会非常喜欢，
fullTextEN: I think dad will really like it,

fullTextZH: 因为这个鸡蛋是儿子做的。
fullTextEN: Because this egg was made by the son.
He eats the egg, he feels——

fullTextZH: 然后他看到了——这一盒鸡蛋不能吃了。
fullTextEN: Then he saw——this box of eggs can't be eaten.
They can't be eaten after February.

fullTextZH: 那你觉得这个爸爸会做什么？
fullTextEN: So what do you think this dad will do?
Dad, he goes to the bathroom.
Go to the bathroom to vomit?
Yes, go to the bathroom to vomit.
He didn't go to the bathroom to vomit,

fullTextZH: 你知道为什么他的儿子——
fullTextEN: Do you know why his son——

fullTextZH: 小男孩——不喜欢鸡蛋了吗？
fullTextEN: The little boy——doesn't like eggs anymore?

fullTextZH: 所以这个鸡蛋煎、煮都不好吃。
fullTextEN: So this egg is not tasty whether fried or boiled.
